opportunities.name: United flight search from home booking form
opportunities.description: Search United flights from {origin} to {destination} on {depart_date}–{return_date} for {travelers} in {cabin}, with trip type and miles options, then review fares.
steps: Open united.com Book > Flight tab
Choose Roundtrip or One-way; optionally tick Book with miles
Type origin city and pick the matching airport suggestion
Type destination city and pick the matching airport suggestion
Open the Dates picker, go to the target month, and click the depart and return dates
Optionally open Travelers and set adults/children counts
Optionally change the cabin class (e.g. Premium economy)
Click Find flights
Optionally open fare details or seats, or select a fare column

instances.values: Sacramento SMF -> Houston IAH, one-way, book with miles, Jun 2
Baltimore BWI -> New York NYC, roundtrip Aug 2–Aug 7, 2 adults
Pune PNQ -> New York NYC, roundtrip Jun 9–11, 1 adult; chose Economy fully-refundable $2,984
Mumbai BOM -> London LON, roundtrip Jul 1–5, 2 adults + 1 child, Premium economy
Springfield SPI -> Austin AUS, one-way, date changed to Apr 29; viewed details/seats
Santa Fe SAF -> Phoenix PHX, roundtrip Aug 13–28, chose Economy $681 outbound and return

opportunities.name: SpotHero event parking search with filters
opportunities.description: Find parking on SpotHero for {event} at {venue}, optionally pick the event date, filter by amenities, adjust entry/exit times, sort, and pick a spot.
steps: Type the venue name in 'Search for parking'
Pick the matching venue suggestion
Optionally open Select Event Date and pick the date
Click the event from the venue's events list
Optionally click Filter, tick amenities (e.g. Wheelchair Accessible), and click Show N Results
Optionally change Start Time / End Time and click Update Search
Optionally change the sort order (Distance/Price)
Optionally click Book Now on a listing

instances.values: Barclays Center, Orlando Magic at Brooklyn Nets, 3:00–5:00 PM, Book Now
Busch Stadium, Pirates at Cardinals Apr 13, Wheelchair Accessible, sorted by price
Barclays Center, Apr 9, 76ers at Brooklyn Nets, Wheelchair Accessible, start 10:00 AM

opportunities.name: Tripadvisor restaurant search by location with filter
opportunities.description: On Tripadvisor Restaurants, search {location}, then apply a {cuisine/feature/dietary} filter to the restaurant list, optionally saving a restaurant to a trip.
steps: Click Restaurants on the Tripadvisor home page
Type the location in the 'Where to?' search box
Select the matching location suggestion (or open 'More restaurants in X')
Click 'Show more' on a filter group if needed
Tick the filter (cuisine, dietary restriction, or feature) and click Apply if a dialog opens
Optionally limit results to the city, open a restaurant, and save it to a new trip

instances.values: Central Park New York, Italian cuisine
Los Angeles, Indian cuisine; saved Urban Masala to new trip 'Los Angeles'

opportunities.name: United Map Search (Explore destinations)
opportunities.description: Use United's Explore destinations map to find flights from {origin}, with trip type and flexible dates, then browse the results.
steps: Open Book > Map search (Explore destinations)
Type the origin in 'Flying from' and pick the airport suggestion
Optionally set the trip type (Roundtrip) and Dates (Flexible dates)
Click Search
Open 'List of search results' or a destination's date link

instances.values: Phoenix PHX, opened list of results
Las Vegas LAS, Roundtrip, Flexible dates
